# Radio Button

```tsx
import { RadioButton, RadioGroup } from "@lucasdost/design-system"
```

Serve para selecionar uma única opção dentro de um conjunto de opções mutuamente exclusivas.

## Example

From the Storybook story; names like `args` or `label` are the story controls.

```tsx
<RadioGroup
  {...args}
  onValueChange={(value, details) => {
    updateArgs({ value })
    args.onValueChange?.(value, details)
  }}
>
  {options.map((option) => (
    <RadioButton
      key={option.value}
      value={option.value}
      label={option.label}
    />
  ))}
</RadioGroup>
```

## Figma notes

Mirrors the Figma Radio Button component:
- State: Default, Read Only (`readOnly`), Disabled (`disabled`)
- Active (`checked`, from the group value)
- Show Label / Label Position / Description as props The accent fill only applies to an interactive radio; Read Only and Disabled keep an outlined circle with a tinted bullet. Neither can be changed, so they have no Focus and leave the tab order, whether the state comes from the radio or from its group.

## Props

Documented props only; every component also accepts the props of the element or Base UI part it renders (`className`, events, ARIA…).

`RadioButton`:

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `label?` | `React.ReactNode` | Figma "Label" (Show Label). Without it only the circle renders. |
| `description?` | `React.ReactNode` | Figma "Description" (Show Description). |
| `labelPosition?` | `"right" \| "left"` | Figma "Label Position". |

`RadioGroup`:

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `label?` | `React.ReactNode` | Group label (Figma .Label). |
| `helpText?` | `React.ReactNode` | Figma "Show Text Help". |
| `direction?` | `"vertical" \| "horizontal"` | Figma "Direction". |

## Rules

- Import `RadioButton` from `@lucasdost/design-system`. Do not rebuild it with plain HTML and Tailwind classes.
- Style it through its props and variants first. Use `className` only for layout (margin, width, grid placement), never to change its colors, typography or radius.
- Colors come from the S0L tokens; see [color](../foundations/color.md).
